//: The laser workspace end to end without a machine: choosing the «Лазер» workspace creates a job and opens it over the model (choosing it again reopens the last job edited, a second job brings up the job picker), a square outline and a small gradient picture are put on the bed (through the node, the way undo would), the square is selected from the object list, and the G-code is generated and previewed. Screenshots show the bed, the selection and the toolpath.

steps.expression: (() => { const node = globalThis.activeDocument.modelManager.findNodes((n) => n.icon === 'icon-layer-group')[0]; if (!node) throw new Error('no laser job in the document'); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 60; c.height = 40; const g = c.getContext('2d'); const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 60, 0); grad.addColorStop(0, '#000'); grad.addColorStop(1, '#fff'); g.fillStyle = grad; g.fillRect(0, 0, 60, 40); const op = (mode) => ({ mode, power: 50, speed: 1000, passes: 1, air: false, fillInterval: 0.5, fillAngle: 45, raster: { mode: 'grayscale', dither: 'floyd', resolution: 5, brightness: 0, contrast: 0, gamma: 1, invert: false, threshold: 50, whiteClip: 5, minPower: 0, overscan: 2 } }); const square = { id: 'sq', name: 'square', kind: 'vector', x: 20, y: 20, width: 50, height: 50, angle: 0, lockAspect: true, sourceWidth: 10, sourceHeight: 10, paths: [{ closed: true, points: [{x:0,y:0},{x:10,y:0},{x:10,y:10},{x:0,y:10}] }, { closed: true, points: [{x:3,y:3},{x:7,y:3},{x:7,y:7},{x:3,y:7}] }], op: op('fill') }; const image = { id: 'img', name: 'gradient', kind: 'image', x: 100, y: 30, width: 60, height: 40, angle: 15, lockAspect: true, dataUrl: c.toDataURL(), pixelWidth: 60, pixelHeight: 40, op: op('image') }; node.content = JSON.stringify({ version: 1, objects: [square, image] }); return node.name; })()

(() => { const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] div')].find((d) => d.textContent === 'square' && d.parentElement && d.parentElement.onclick); if (!row) throw new Error('no object row'); row.parentElement.click(); const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] input[type=number]'); return inputs.length; })()

(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] button')].find((x) => x.textContent === 'Рассчитать G-code' || x.textContent === 'Generate G-code'); if (!b) throw new Error('no generate button'); b.click(); return true; })()

(() => { const paths = document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] svg g[pointer-events=none] path'); if (paths.length < 3) throw new Error('no toolpath preview: ' + paths.length); const status = document.querySelector('dialog[open] div:last-child > span').textContent; if (!/\d+:\d\d/.test(status)) throw new Error('no time estimate: ' + status); return status; })()

(() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] div')].find((x) => (x.textContent === 'Станок' || x.textContent === 'Machine') && x.onclick); if (!tab) throw new Error('no machine tab'); tab.click(); const stop = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] button')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'СТОП' || b.textContent === 'STOP'); if (!stop) throw new Error('no stop button'); return { serial: 'serial' in navigator, stopDisabledOffline: stop.disabled }; })()

(() => { const jobs = globalThis.activeDocument.modelManager.findNodes((n) => n.icon === 'icon-layer-group'); if (jobs.length !== 2) throw new Error('expected two jobs, got ' + jobs.length); const picker = document.querySelector('dialog[open] select'); if (!picker || picker.options.length !== 2 || picker.style.display === 'none') throw new Error('no job picker'); document.querySelector('chili-main-toolbar').switchWorkspace('ribbon.workspace.laser'); const again = globalThis.activeDocument.modelManager.findNodes((n) => n.icon === 'icon-layer-group'); if (again.length !== 2) throw new Error('the workspace made another job'); return picker.value === again[1].id; })()
